principles: Small monthly charges add up quietly; review them as a set, not one at a time.
Keep the ones you use every week and cancel or pause the rest.
Watch for free trials that turned into paid plans.

gentle.title: Your subscriptions are creeping up
gentle.body: Subscriptions came to {subscription_spend_last_month} last month, up {subscription_spend_rise} over the last {subscription_rise_streak} months. It might be worth a quick look through the list to see which ones you still use.

blunt.title: Subscriptions up {subscription_rise_streak} months running
blunt.body: You spent {subscription_spend_last_month} on subscriptions last month, {subscription_spend_rise} more than {subscription_rise_streak} months ago. Go through the list today and cancel anything you have not used this month.
